versions.content: When CanIf_Transmit is called and the container CanI- fTxPduCfg . CanIfTxPduXLParams is existing which indicates a CAN XL frame, the CanXL_Params passed to CanXL_Write shall be composed as described in 86 of 224 Document ID 12: AUTOSAR_SWS_CANInterface Specification of CAN Interface AUTOSAR CP R22-11 [SWS_CANIF_00938] of the CAN XL parameters configured in CanIfTxPduXL- Params , and those passed as MetaData via the ->MetaDataPtr .
